title: Rhythmic Wah Groove
purpose: Expose wah timing, repeatable pedal movement, parked-filter control, and phrase-level sweeps over a sparse groove with clear subdivisions.
feel: straight-sixteenth funk-rock pulse with deliberate guitar space

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: tight dry kit defining subdivisions without fills that mask pedal timing

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: short supportive electric bass pulse with room for muted wah rhythm

tracks.name: Keys
tracks.instrument_intent: light electric-piano harmony; avoid continuous upper-mid activity

provenance.notes: Original funk-rock practice groove designed for synchronized wah movement and parked-filter comparisons.
